reported_boundary: PM live06 native roundtrip passed; staged draft changed footer to '@ files · # issues' and typing sensor returned unavailable. Historical receipt has no cursor coordinates, so none are inferred or backfilled.

capture_contract.coordinates: Actual zero-based tmux viewport coordinates; never inferred from draft length, border position or transcript
capture_contract.viewport: Unjoined physical rows, no -J or scrollback; raw-output opt-in preserves blank rows through the real command adapter. Existing joined terminal/scrollback captures retain their previous behavior.
capture_contract.failure: Captured before typing assertions, including unavailable sensor failures. Malformed/unavailable metadata retains explicit error and any available screen/raw metadata, with no invented coordinates.
capture_contract.timing: One tmux command batch after the sensor/file/DB observation. Nearby harness evidence, not an atomic snapshot of the daemon's earlier sensor read.
capture_contract.replay_consumer: composer_region(capture: &str, cursor_x: u32, cursor_y: u32), crates/harnesses/src/composer.rs; no Rust changes or recognizer replay executed here

initial_red.reason: Missing pane_capture in typing observations and final panes

whitespace_red.reason: Existing command stdout trim removed actual trailing viewport rows; fixed via explicit raw-output opt-in, not synthetic padding

failure_path_red.reason: Source review identified missing viewport receipt after scrollback failure; independent viewport capture now survives scrollback-only failure and records nested error/timestamp when the pane exits

review.scope: Source-only follow-up confirmed independent viewport receipt on both scrollback branches; no commands or tests run by reviewer

final_tests.scope: Injected tmux boundary tests, not actual tmux/Copilot execution; prior consent, typing, lifecycle and installer assertions retained

typecheck.command: node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit --strict --noUncheckedIndexedAccess --skipLibCheck --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --target ES2022 --esModuleInterop --types node harness/scripts/link-global.ts harness/scripts/link-global.test.ts harness/scripts/copilot-native-fixture.ts harness/scripts/copilot-native-smoke.ts harness/scripts/copilot-native-smoke.test.ts

harness_lesson.encoded: Capture actual viewport coordinates with physical rows, preserve raw whitespace, and retain evidence before assertions; text-only screenshots cannot reconstruct cursor geometry.
